name: Bizarre Otaku Love
source:
You've just been transferred to a new school!

New friends! (just extras really).
A chance for a better quality study! (actually no one is going to study here), but still a bit of romance is missing, and what better could accompany a sweet romance, than a bag full of clichés, right?!!
The goddesses of clichés are in love with you, the perfect protagonist! You must manage to survive and in the end choose the Best Girl!

[Translated from [url=https://crying-star-games.itch.io/bizarre-otaku-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚转学到一所新学校！

新朋友！（真的只是额外的）。
获得更高质量学习的机会！（实际上没有人会在这里学习），但还是少了一点浪漫，还有什么比一袋陈词滥调更能陪伴甜蜜的浪漫呢，对吧？！
俗套的女神爱上了你，完美的主角！你必须设法生存并最终选择最好的女孩！

[译自[url=https://crying-star-games.itch.io/bizarre-otaku-love]Itch.io[/url]]
